name: chat
title: Chat
description: A self-contained AI chat surface: streaming conversation UI, a history switcher, a tool-call renderer seam you own, and a Route Handler that runs every turn through the execution boundary. Ships with a deterministic stub model so a clean install streams with no API keys. The Route Handler imports lib/intelligo.ts (the composition root) and lib/plans.ts, which are provided by the `intelligo create` scaffold, not by any registry item - in a hand-rolled app, create both before installing (see the CLI's app-scaffold templates).
